study type: secondary analysis of a randomized controlled trial
exposure: buccal misoprostol combined with a Foley catheter for induction of labor
vaginal misoprostol combined with a Foley catheter for induction of labor
cohort: The study included 215 obese women (BMI >= 30 kg/m2) undergoing induction of labor at >=37 weeks with a singleton gestation and cervical dilation <=2 cm.
finding: Vaginal misoprostol combined with a Foley catheter resulted in a faster median time to delivery compared to buccal misoprostol in obese individuals undergoing induction of labor.
mod_finding: There was no difference in the cesarean delivery rate between the buccal and vaginal misoprostol groups.
